title: Stalks commute with total tensor products of sheaf complexes
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, let $F^\bullet$ and $K^\bullet$ be complexes of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let $x\in X$. There is a natural isomorphism of complexes of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules $(F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}K^\bullet)_x \cong F_x^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}K_x^\bullet$ for the total tensor construction [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], where both sides use the total-complex direct sums and tensor differential.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma Tag 06YB (label lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), tensor-stalk identification

proof.text: Choose the natural module tensor comparisons from [lem-pc-ringed-space-module-stalk-tensor]. Apply [lem-pc-stalk-tensor-complex-degrees] to obtain the diagonal degree isomorphisms and their injection formulas.

Prove stalk additivity using the additive abelian-group stalk functor, then use [lem-pc-stalk-tensor-complex-differential] and HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents to assemble the complex isomorphisms.

Prove naturality by checking after each stalked summand injection. Transport hom-ext through the degree isomorphism and the component tensor isomorphisms. The injection formula for mapBifunctorMap and naturality of the module tensor comparison identify both composites.
